'''Yuun''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bouncer]] who followed [[Darovit]] around while he walked the [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] forests. She was with him when they discovered that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] was building a monument to the one hundred fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]]. She fled the scene when he was discovered by the [[Jedi Ambassador|Jedi Advisor]] [[Johun Othone]].
